newsitem.title: LATVIA: RTF TO PROPOSE ONE SANTIME DIVIDEND.
newsitem.headline: RTF TO PROPOSE ONE SANTIME DIVIDEND.

text.p: Riga Transport Fleet (RTF), an official list stock, said on Wednesday that it will propose to distribute its 1996 profit for dividends, paying a one santime dividend per share.
"The supervisory council will propose to the general shareholders' meeting to approve a decision to direct the 1996 profit into divident payment," Oleg Kolosov, RTF general manager, told Reuters.
RTF earlier reported a 1996 profit of 182,719 lats against 1995 profit of 172,418.
The company in 1996 saw net turnover of 11.44 million lats in 1996 versus 12.60 million lats the year before.
